facts.text: John shared a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a sailboat in the distance during a walk last week.

evidence.quote: Yeah, Maria. Little things like this can make a big impact in how we think. Oh, and here's a pic I got from my walk last week. It always reminds me to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.

facts.text: Maria expressed admiration for the photo, noting the vibrant colors and the calmness of the ocean it conveyed.

evidence.quote: That picture is amazing! The colors are so vibrant - really shows the calmness of the ocean.

facts.text: John mentioned seeing sunsets like the one in the photo at least once a week during his walks.

evidence.quote: I see them at least once a week. It's a good way to disconnect, think, and find peace in this crazy world.

facts.text: Maria mentioned she has been taking regular 'me-time' walks at a nearby park and found it to have a significant impact.

evidence.quote: I've been taking regular 'me-time' walks at the park nearby and It's made a big impact.
